description.html: At 120 cm, this is the tallest terrarium in our range. The base is 80x30 cm, the volume 288 liters. It is shallow, so against a wall it takes up as much room as a bookshelf. The entire back, 80 cm wide and 120 cm high, is covered by a 3D background of carved styrofoam.

For an adult chameleon, 120 cm of height gives a full range from the warm top to the cooler bottom. A green tree python and emerald tree boa use horizontal branches up to 80 cm long, set at several heights. The 30 cm depth is a limitation: plants and branches go in a single row along the background. A pair of crested geckos uses the whole wall for climbing.

We build a deeper base, 40 or 50 cm, to order if you have the room. At this height, let us know where it will stand, so that the sliding front glass is easy to reach. The build takes 7 to 14 days, and delivery of a terrarium this tall should be arranged with us in advance. You choose the shape of the background, rock or bark, before the build starts.
